verifications.claim: Coachella sets typically last 45 to 55 minutes for most artists.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R2 examples: 'Hot Mulligan: 10–10:45pm' (45 min), 'Holly Humberstone: 8:25–9:10pm' (45 min), 'Ninajirachi: 7:10–8pm' (50 min); R3 similar 40-55 min sets on smaller stages like Sonora, Gobi.
verifications.reasoning: Schedules show many non-headliner sets in 40-55 min range, supporting typical duration but not explicitly stated as '45-55 for most'.

verifications.claim: Coachella headliners usually perform for 1.5 to 2 hours.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Sabrina Carpenter: 9:05–10:35pm' (90 min), 'Green Day: 9:05-10:45pm' (100 min, R3); late main stage slots often 90+ min like 'Lady Gaga: 11:10pm' (implied long set).
verifications.reasoning: Headliner slots on Coachella Stage often 90-120 min, but some shorter (e.g. 'The Strokes: 9–10:10pm' 70 min), generally supports but not precisely 'usually 1.5-2h' stated.

verifications.claim: Coachella earlier acts may play for 30–40 minutes.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Febuary: 1:40–2:10pm' (30 min), 'Doom Dave: 1–1:40pm' (40 min); R3 Sonora early: 'Glixen: 2–2:30pm' (30 min), 'vs self: 3–3:30pm' (30 min).
verifications.reasoning: Many early/small stage sets are 30-40 min, supporting claim but described via specific examples, not general rule.

verifications.claim: Special performances such as those on the Quasar stage at Coachella can last 3–4 hours.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R2 Quasar: 'Tiga: 5–7pm' (2h), 'Deep Dish: 7–9pm' (2h), 'PAWSA: 9–11pm' (2h); R3: 'Rafael x Muluhska: 5–7pm' (2h); no 3-4h sets shown.
verifications.reasoning: Quasar sets consistently 2h in schedules; directly contradicts 3-4h claim.

verifications.claim: Coachella sets generally run until 1 a.m. on Friday/Saturday and midnight on Sunday.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R2/R3: 'When the fest wraps up for the day around 1am'; Fri/Sat e.g. 'Gordo: 11:15pm–12:55am'; Sunday 'Surprise: 10:45pm–midnight' (Do LaB); R1 grids to 1am all days.
verifications.reasoning: Sources indicate ~1am close Fri/Sat, Sunday ~midnight in some schedules; supports generally but not exact Fri/Sat vs Sunday distinction stated.

verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Sabrina Carpenter: 9:05–10:35pm' (90 min); R3: 'Green Day: 9:05-10:45pm' (100 min); late slots imply 90+ min.
verifications.reasoning: Matches headliner durations in schedules (90-100+ min), but some shorter and not explicitly generalized.

verifications.claim: Coachella sub-headliners/Main Stage acts perform for 60–75 minutes.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R2 Coachella Stage pre-headliners: 'The xx: 7–7:55pm' (55 min), 'GIVĒON: 7–7:50pm' (50 min); some ~60 min like 'Teddy Swims: 5:30–6:20pm' (50 min).
verifications.reasoning: Some main stage non-headliners ~50-60 min, close to 60-75 but range varies, supported loosely by examples.

verifications.claim: Coachella other artists perform for 45–55 minutes.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Joyce Manor: 5:10–5:50pm' (40 min), 'CMAT: 6:15–6:55pm' (40 min), 'Hot Mulligan: 10–10:45pm' (45 min); many 40-55 min sets.
verifications.reasoning: Patterns in schedules show frequent 40-55 min for non-main acts, supporting but not precisely '45-55' stated.

verifications.claim: Coachella Quasar Stage sets last 3–4 hours.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Joezi: 5–7pm' (2h), 'Afrojack x Shimza: 7–9pm' (2h); R3: 'Tripolism x EREZ: 5–7pm' (2h); consistent 2h slots.
verifications.reasoning: All Quasar sets listed as 2h; directly contradicts 3-4h.
